asset.label: North Shore Health Region — reversed white logo with Sharing a Vision of Health
asset.publisher: Trans Canada Trail, North Vancouver pavilion panel
asset.sourceLocator: Rebuilt from the 1999/2000 Annual Report cover logo's native paths (north-shore-health-region-annual-report-2000.svg), reversed as the later Trans Canada Trail donor-panel raster shows the logo
asset.dateNote: PDF creation metadata. Filename has 2017-04-18. These later file dates are not evidence of the logo’s original adoption date.
asset.notes: The reversed logo: frame, mountain, NORTH SHORE, Health Region and the tagline in white, with lettering the colour version draws in white over green cut out of the white. White artwork, for a dark ground; the same design as the green annual-report logo.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector rebuild, not original reversed artwork: the 1999/2000 annual report's own logo paths, unchanged, reversed through a mask (green there is white here, white there is open), so it is exactly that design in the raster's colourway. The donor-panel raster is too small (118×124 px) to show whether the reversed original differed in detail; the raster is kept as this rebuild's version.
